Data.UnitTalk_JPN: トレーニング中に<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>が怪我をした。

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 별거 아니라고 이야기하지만 아무래도 마음에 걸린다.

Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は大したことないと言うが、やはり心配だ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>说没什么大不了的，但还是有点令人担心。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>說沒什麼大不了的，但還是有點令人擔心。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a dit que ce n'était rien de grave, mais ça me tracasse quand même.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sagte, es sei nichts Ernstes, aber es beunruhigte mich trotzdem.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Aunque <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> insistió en que no era nada grave, me preocupó.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Embora <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> tenha dito que não era nada sério, eu ainda estava preocupado.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แม้ว่า <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> จะบอกว่าไม่เป็นอะไรมาก แต่ฉันก็ยังอดเป็นห่วงไม่ได้
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Meskipun <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bersikeras itu bukan apa-apa, aku tetap khawatir.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Dù <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> nói không sao, nhưng tôi vẫn cảm thấy lo lắng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने कहा कि यह कुछ खास नहीं था, लेकिन फिर भी मुझे चिंता हुई।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: As Captain, what should I do?

Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Como Capitão, o que devo fazer?

Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Với tư cách là Đội trưởng, tôi nên làm gì đây?
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: कप्तान के तौर पर मुझे क्या करना चाहिए?

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Đưa ra một Bình Thuốc Sinh Lực.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 알겠다고 대답했지만 어쩐지 기운이 없어 보인다.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(와)과 함께 부상 위험이 없는 훈련을 진행했다.
